outcome.rejected: Rejected on {{when}}. Nothing was carried out.
outcome.expired: Expired: nobody decided in time. Nothing was carried out.

approval.not_found: This release does not exist (any more), or you may not see it.
approval.not_addressed: Only the person who asked the agent decides.
approval.not_permitted: You may not (any more) do yourself what the agent wants to do, so you cannot release it either.
approval.decided: This release has been decided already.
approval.expired: This release has expired; the agent stopped waiting.
approval.run_ended: The run no longer waits for it (it finished or was cancelled).
approval.version_conflict: The release has changed meanwhile. It was reloaded.
